stages.name: First Steps
stages.text: Rule begins with the ledger. Open your capital's scroll and set its tax level — squeeze too hard and the streets will remember.

stages.name: Foundations
stages.text: A settlement is what you build in it. Queue a construction project anywhere you rule.

stages.name: The Muster
stages.text: Coin does not hold a wall. Recruit a unit — soldiers are drawn from the settlement's own people, so watch the population.

stages.name: Eyes of the House
stages.text: A city without a governor drifts. Keep a grown man of your line standing in your capital and the seat is his.

stages.name: A Banner in the Field
stages.text: Garrisons guard; armies decide. Raise a field army from a garrison — it marches out under your best commander present.

stages.name: On the March
stages.text: March an army into a neighboring region. Roads and terrain set the pace; a season's movement is spent step by step.

stages.name: The Old Roads
stages.text: The map keeps its secrets close. Somewhere near your lands a marked site waits — march an army onto it and order a search.

stages.name: Wayfarers
stages.text: One find is luck; three are a habit. Search out two more of the map's marked places, wherever your banners can reach.

stages.name: Iron Discipline
stages.text: Better yards breed better soldiers. Queue a barracks-line building and your recruits will carry the drill with them forever.

stages.name: Hired Blades
stages.text: Wars are won with the soldiers you can get. Hire a mercenary band into a field army — or raise three units of your own instead.

stages.name: The War Chest
stages.text: Campaigns run on grain and silver. Bring the treasury to twenty thousand denarii and your quartermasters will find the rest.

stages.name: The Senate's Counsel
stages.text: The conscript fathers reward houses that serve. Complete a senate mission before their patience thins.

stages.name: First Blood
stages.text: Sooner or later the field decides. Win a pitched battle — attack at good odds, or make an attacker regret the ground.

stages.name: Break Their Walls
stages.text: Take a settlement that is not yours: lay siege, build equipment or starve them out, then decide the city's fate.

stages.name: Grow the House
stages.text: Four regions under one banner make a power the map must reckon with. Hold four.

stages.name: The Long Road
stages.text: Six regions, one will. From here the trail ends and the age itself is the prize — the victory scroll shows what remains.

stages.name: Alarum of War
stages.text: War is upon you — by your hand or a rival's. Answer in steel: win a battle, or take a settlement.

stages.name: Break the Siege
stages.text: An enemy sits before one of your cities. Drive the besiegers off before the granaries empty — a relief army, a sally, whatever it takes.

stages.name: Drive Them Out
stages.text: Enemy soldiers stand in or beside your lands. Clear the borders — destroy them, or make them think better of it.

stages.name: Steady the Ledgers
stages.text: The treasury has run dry and the moneylenders are circling. Climb back to a thousand denarii — raise taxes, trim the payroll, sell your sword.
